verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a GPU sold with an official software ecosystem (NVIDIA app, G-Assist, CUDA toolkit) could plausibly ship an official MCP server. However, nothing in the evidence documents an MCP server or endpoint an agent could connect to. The llms.txt probe and the G-Assist assistant are adjacent features, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
